title: Learning Sequential Mobility Choice: A Review of Route and Activity Choice through Inverse Reinforcement and Imitation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Route and activity choice are connected levels of a common sequential mobility decision problem: activity choice determines what people do, where, and when, while route choice governs how they move between activities. This review develops a unified framework connecting transportation choice modeling with inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and imitation learning (IL). Under explicit assumptions, recursive logit, logit dynamic discrete choice, and maximum-entropy IRL share a soft Bellman representation, while trajectory occupancies and network flows satisfy related conservation laws. However, utility, reward, policy, occupancy, constraints, and observation errors remain different estimands with different behavioral and counterfactual interpretations. translated_title: 学习顺序出行选择：基于逆强化学习与模仿学习的路径与活动选择综述
translated_abstract: 路径选择和活动选择是同一个顺序出行决策问题的两个相互关联层面：活动选择决定了人们做什么、在哪里以及何时做，而路径选择则支配着他们如何在活动之间移动。本综述构建了一个统一框架，将交通出行选择建模与逆强化学习（IRL）和模仿学习（IL）联系起来。在明确假设下，递归logit模型、logit动态离散选择模型和最大熵IRL共享一种软贝尔曼表示，而轨迹占用率和网络流满足相关的守恒定律。然而，效用、奖励、策略、占用率、约束和观测误差仍然是不同的估计量，具有不同的行为和反事实解释。我们回顾了约束和逆约束学习、占用率比和DICE方法、不完整和混合质量演示、图和序列学习、迁移、数据融合、多智能体以及在线和离线IL方法。最后，我们讨论了将IRL/IL用于顺序出行决策建模的开放挑战和未来方向，包括行为解释、可扩展性、公平性和隐私问题。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，将路径与活动选择建模与逆强化学习和模仿学习相结合，阐明了它们共享的软贝尔曼表示，并系统综述了相关方法、挑战和未来方向。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework connecting route and activity choice modeling with inverse reinforcement learning and imitation learning, revealing their shared soft Bellman representation and systematically reviewing methods, challenges, and future directions.
